services.name: Wild Horses
services.desc: The W-Class story begins in 1995 after Donald Tofias bought the venerable double-ended, Burgess-designed cutter Christmas, renamed her Arawak, and asked Joel White to make her faster by designing a new lead ballast keel to replace her original iron one, and a taller, more modern rig to go with it. In the process, Donald got to know Joel and Steve White, as well as Taylor Allen whose Rockport, Maine, yard would be executing the changes. Tofias, having observed J-boats and how much fun racing such boats can be, came up with the idea of reintroducing one-design racing in big boats to the current racing fraternity. services.name: Yacht Design
services.desc: With an experienced team of yacht designers coming from a wide variety of backgrounds, the BBY design office has the expertise to take on varied and complex designs for both power and sailboats and contribute at any stage of the yacht design process for projects in the BBY shop and in cooperation with other designers and boatbuilders. Many of our custom projects start from a blank sheet of paper. Through discussions, sketches, and preliminary calculations we work with clients to clarify their vision for a design and establish the general framework that will guide the rest of the design process. blurb: Brooklin Boat Yard combines Maine craftsmanship with modern technology to create world-class yachts. They offer custom wooden yacht building, design, and major refits. They also provide maintenance and service for yachts, including summer preparation and emergency repairs.
